'''Christian McCarty''' (forums handle '''ketura''') is a volunteer of the [[Players Committee]]. The Players Committee organization chart of 6 May 2024 lists Christian McCarty as GEMP Infrastructure in the GEMP team, under the [[Rules Advocate]] [[Greg Zinn]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref> See [[Players Committee organization]].

McCarty co-founded the Player's Council for [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]] in June 2020 and is the Administrator of its website, lotrtcgpc.net.<ref name="lotrpc" /><ref name="ghketura">[https://github.com/ketura ketura], GitHub profile of Christian McCarty. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020161429/https://github.com/ketura Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="bill" /> The Lord of the Rings TCG [[GEMP]] shares its codebase with the SWCCG GEMP.<ref name="lotrabout">[https://lotrtcgpc.net/about.html About the Player's Council], lotrtcgpc.net ("the Star Wars PC (who use the same software)"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020161232/https://lotrtcgpc.net/about.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gemplotr">[https://github.com/PlayersCouncil/gemp-lotr PlayersCouncil/gemp-lotr], GitHub (README). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020161311/https://github.com/PlayersCouncil/gemp-lotr Internet Archive]</ref>
